notes:
WHAT THIS SITE IS TODAY: bedbathandbeyond.com is NOT the original Bed Bath & Beyond retailer, which was liquidated in 2023. The domain is now operated by Beyond Inc. (formerly Overstock.com), which bought the brand and relaunched it on the Overstock e-commerce platform. Confirmed from the origin HTML itself: the page state carries Overstock platform flags ("isOverstock":false, "isBackyard":false, "isBuyBuyBaby":false), product images are served from the Overstock CDN ak1.ostkcdn.com, product URLs use the Overstock /<Dept>/<slug>/<id>/product.html form, footer social links still carry aria-labels reading 'Overstock on Facebook/Instagram/X/Pinterest/YouTube', and the store card is the 'Overstock Mastercard'. The homepage also shows a cross-brand bar linking to containerstore.com, consistent with the group consolidation seen last batch on Kirkland's. So this is a live, very large marketplace-style catalogue - not a retired one - but it is Beyond Inc.'s catalogue wearing the Bed Bath & Beyond name.

ACCESS ROUTE: the homepage fetched directly (HTTP 200) but every /c/ category listing was Akamai 403 'Access Denied'. A 13-profile curl_cffi sweep failed - only safari18_0_ios got a 200, and that was an Akamai Bot Manager behavioural interstitial, not content. r.jina.ai was also 403. The route that worked was translate.goog (www-bedbathandbeyond-com.translate.goog/<path>?_x_tr_sl=en&_x_tr_tl=es&_x_tr_hl=en), which returns genuine server-rendered origin HTML including the count header. All link values below are the canonical bedbathandbeyond.com origin URLs.

COUNTS AND HOW THEY WERE VERIFIED: every category page server-renders three independent count signals - the visible header ('1 - 60 of N Results'), an embedded "resultCount":N, and a JSON-LD ItemList "numberOfItems":N. All three agreed on every row emitted. Verified empirically by exhaustion on Stained Glass Panels (208): paginating &page=1..4 and collecting unique product IDs out of the JSON-LD product-container gave a union of exactly 208 (60+60+60+28), and &page=5 fell back to page 1. Note each page's JSON-LD carries 81 tiles, not 60 - the extra 21 are a next-page prefetch that overlaps the following page (p1&p2 overlap 21, p1&p3 overlap 0), which is why tile-counting overstates and the reported total is the correct number.

RE-CUTS DROPPED (verified, not assumed): 'Framed Art' (42,542) is a cross-cut, not a branch - 25,730 Framed Canvas + 16,812 Framed Prints = 42,542 exactly, and a page-1 ID sample overlapped Framed Canvas 33/60 and Framed Prints 13/60 with zero overlap against Wrapped Canvas. Dropped. Likewise 'Wall Art Sets' (980) overlapped Framed Canvas Sets 75/135, and the four '...Sets' nodes sit inside their parent types (Canvas Art 62,197 = 36,467 Wrapped + 25,730 Framed exactly; Printed Art 16,948 = 16,812 Framed + 136 Unframed exactly) - all dropped. 'Alarm Clocks' (42) dropped: 861 Wall + 225 Tabletop + 6 Floor = 1,092 = the Clocks parent exactly, and alarm clocks overlapped Tabletop 22/42. 'Kitchen Island Lights' (9,269) dropped as a re-cut of Pendant Lights (25/60 sample overlap). Broad parent roll-ups (Decor, Wall Decor 37,907, Decorative Accessories 21,085, Art 92,906, Ceiling Lights 24,010, Lamps 7,919, Barware and Drinkware 7,995) are emitted as parent grouping rows only, never with a qty. Desk Lamps vs Table Lamps and Mugs vs Drinking Glasses were checked and showed 0% overlap, so both were kept.

DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: the whole 'Home Fragrances' node (1,376) and its Candles child (1,285) - reading actual product titles showed it is overwhelmingly scented (Yankee Candle jars, WoodWick, wax melts, room sprays, essential oils, reed and oil diffusers). Its unscented siblings were kept instead: Candle Holders (1,666) and Flameless Candles (99), the latter title-checked as LED/battery flameless. Also excluded per scope: Faux Plants & Flowers, Wallpaper, Wall Murals and Wall Decals (wall coverings), Tapestries and Throw Pillows (textiles), Rugs, Window Treatments, Holiday and Gifts, Room Dividers, Coffee Table Books and Record Players (not decor), Photo Albums, Message Boards, all Furniture, Bedding, Bath, Mattresses, Storage, Appliances, Cookware, Flatware/Cutlery, Bar & Wine Tools, Flasks, Travel Mugs and Water Bottles, Serving Utensils, Ceiling Fans, Light Bulbs, and architectural/task lighting (Recessed, Track, Indoor Spotlights, Under Cabinet, Step, and bathroom Vanity Lights).

RULE 0 TOP-UP ADDENDUM (2026-08-10): re-visited the live nav (mega-menu, via the same translate.goog route) specifically for room-based lighting/mirror branches the original pass skipped under 'architectural/task lighting' reasoning. Recovered and verified live via the rendered header + resultCount + JSON-LD numberOfItems triple-check (all three agreed on every row): Recessed Lighting (120), Track Lighting (99), Under Cabinet Lights (90), Bathroom Vanity Lights (4,914), Bathroom Vanity Mirrors (1,021). Also found and added an entire branch the original pass never mentioned at all (not even as excluded) - Outdoor Lighting: Outdoor Wall Lights (2,757), Outdoor Ceiling Lights (1,470), Landscape Lighting (770), Post Lights (392), Outdoor String Lights (121), Security Lighting (99) - all six independently verified the same way. Kitchen Island Lights (flagged 'dropped as a re-cut of Pendant Lights' in the original notes) was re-tested per the brief's specific caution that its ~9,269 figure needed empirical re-verification, not a copy: the live resultCount/numberOfItems both now say 9257, but the page's own RENDERED header refuses to confirm an exact number above 5,000 ('of 5,000+ Results'), and requesting page=85 or page=100 both silently redirect back to page=84, topping out at '4981 - 5040 of 5,000+ Results' - the site will not actually serve or confirm any product past #5040 through pagination. A fresh page-1 product-ID sample also still overlaps Pendant Lights at 39/82 (~48%), consistent with the original 25/60 finding. Because neither 9257 nor the ~5040 pagination cap is independently confirmable as the exact count, this row is recorded qty:null with a MANUAL REVIEW flag rather than being copied or estimated, per THE ONE RULE THAT MATTERS. Indoor Spotlights and Step Lights remain excluded (not room-based, and not named in this top-up's known-loss list); Kitchen-and-Bath and Outdoor lighting facet re-cuts (shape/style query-param variants of the Mirrors category t=28403, e.g. Round/Arched/Rectangle/Full Length/Decorative/Window Pane Mirrors) were checked and confirmed to be pure filter facets of the already-kept 'Mirrors' parent, not separate categories - correctly left out. All new rows fetched via the same translate.goog mirror route as the rest of this file (direct fetch still returns Akamai 403); canonical bedbathandbeyond.com origin URLs are kept in every 'link' field.
